title: lupinus angustifolius subsp. reticulatus
intro: Lupinus angustifolius subsp. reticulatus, commonly known as Narrow-leafed Lupin, is a plant species within the Lupinus genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing the risk of certain diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus angustifolius subsp. reticulatus include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit neuroprotective effects, and have potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
